The applicant/accused has been found guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 376(3), 450 &
326 IPC and Section 3 read with Section 4 & Section 5(l) read with Section 6 of the PoCSO Act.
The applicant/accused has been sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the aforesaid offences.

This is an application filed under Section 389(1) Cr.P.C., seeking suspension of sentence of the applicant/accused in S.C. No.333 of 2021 on the file of the Court of Session, Kozhikode.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The applicant/accused has been found guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 376(3), 450 &
326 IPC and Section 3 read with Section 4 & Section 5(l) read with Section 6 of the PoCSO Act.
As the appeal is of the year 2024, there is no possibility of the appeal being taken up for hearing in the near future.
Hence, in the facts and circumstances of the case and also taking into account the fact that the applicant/accused has been in custody from 2023 onwards, the substantive sentence of imprisonment imposed on the applicant/accused is suspended till the disposal of the appeal subject to the following conditions:-
i) The applicant/accused shall be released on bail on executing a bond for 50,000/-
(Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial court;
ii) He shall deposit the entire fine amount within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
iii) He shall not commit any offence(s) while on bail;
iv) He shall not contact or try to intimidate the witnesses examined in the case;
v) If the conviction and sentence of the applicant/accused is upheld or even modified,
the time during which he is so released shall be excluded in computing the term of his sentence as provided in Section 389(4) Cr.P.C.
vi) It is also made clear that if any of the conditions are violated, the bail shall stand cancelled.
Post on 14/08/2025.
